play.comments:
The following players DENNIS and CAROLINE on 10/09/19 in THE APARTMENT successfully escaped from the secret lab.
What an outstanding accomplishment, and how fortunate that they now won’t have to be locked up forever inside the lab!
To do it, it took them 98 minutes and 32 seconds. They used a total of 7 Help Cards. This earned them 3 stars in the assessment! The coolest riddle was USING THE POINTER TO DRAW A CIRCLE ON THE INSTRUCTIONS. The trickiest riddle was THE UNIVERSAL ONE. The player who solved this riddle was THE HELP CARDS.
